description: We want to supply CLT structural walls for an encapsulated mass timber apartment building, ten storeys and sixty units. Our proposed adhesive has room-temperature bond data only. We are explicitly proposing not to meet the elevated-temperature adhesive performance requirements in the CLT product standard, using extra panel thickness as our rationale.

missing_info.field: adhesive documentation and proposed alternative evidence
missing_info.why: Request evidence; extra thickness is an applicant proposal, not an accepted professional conclusion.

missing_info.field: owner or representative contact and property identification
risk assessment, mitigating measures, assumptions and supporting documents
missing_info.why: Alternative-path completeness items; request evidence rather than fabricate a professional conclusion.

gold.departure: CLT structural mass timber uses adhesive without the required elevated-temperature performance conformity.
gold.engineering_reason: The stated occupancy, building size or dwelling count is outside the Division C exemption; applicable drawings require qualified registered professionals.
